name: Erastone
description: (Tag:bound)Dubbed "Absolute Limitation", Erastone is a crown Teigu whose jewel shines light that shatters all of the target's equipment and items weaker than Legendary rank. The jewel shatters after use and regenerates after a week-long cooldown. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
